title: Star · R2-08 (1 of 2) — 5-second Undo on “Private testing set”
subtitle: The toast gets the same Undo button as Star’s other Undo toasts (e.g. “Alex Kim moved back to the testing day · fee $140 · Undo”, bottom of the Today column): text · thin divider · ↶ Undo. Undo puts the old private day and time back, or clears a newly set one, then the toast says “Undone”. The Set / Change private testing dialog has already closed when the toast shows, so Undo can be reached by mouse and keyboard like any other toast. The make-up toast is a separate choice: picture A3b. Both toast texts (“Private testing set”, “Drew Park added”) are still marked PROPOSAL in the code: these pictures are the first time they are shown for approval, and an OK here removes the PROPOSAL tags.

columns.note: Undo works for 5 seconds; hovering or focusing the toast pauses the time, as on every toast. Build check: on the tablet the wider toast covers more of the bottom row; when the edited candidate is the bottom row, its ⋯ (where focus returns) must not sit under the toast.

footer: Star testing · rolling check pass 1, Step A (plan OK’d 2026-11-06). Preview screenshots (fake database, admin, Fall Star Testing). The “After” column is drawn over the real page by a small script (mock-stepA.js) — nothing in the app was changed. Amber = what changes; green = the change.
